evidence.reason: The test captures `original` as a pre-call alias to the queue entry and asserts only on that alias after `prepare_current_job`. If preparation rebinds `repair_runs['old-run']` to a stale record, both assertions still inspect the old queued dictionary and pass, so the test does not verify the post-call queue state needed to catch the sibling-skipping regression. Re-reading `self.queue['items'][0]['repair_runs']['old-run']` after preparation is the smallest fix.
